# Kumtech Gateway

> Kumtech Gateway is a Yaoundé-based digital solutions business that helps businesses in Cameroon and suitable remote clients build a trusted identity, professional website, stronger local visibility and consistent communication.

Canonical website: [https://kumtechgateway.com/](https://kumtechgateway.com/)

Kumtech Gateway primarily serves Yaoundé and businesses across Cameroon. It can also support suitable remote projects internationally. The business should not be described as a software product, marketplace or training institution.

## Core services

- Branding: Visual identity systems that improve recognition, consistency and trust. Starting from 75,000 XAF.
- Website design and development: Responsive professional websites designed for credibility and clear customer action. Starting from 100,000 XAF.
- Google Business Profile: Setup and improvement for stronger local discovery and accurate business information. Starting from 25,000 XAF.
- Graphic design: Consistent visual communication for everyday business needs. Category pricing applies.
- Social media management: Planned content and publishing shaped around the business account. Starting from 30,000 XAF per month.

## Business Presence Audit

The Business Presence Audit reviews identity, digital presence, visibility, communication, trust and conversion before recommending a service.

## Selected projects

- Faith Construction Ltd: Brand identity, website, SEO and content systems.
- GOMIO: Brand strategy, product interface direction and digital experience for a Cameroon delivery platform.
- Kumtech Gateway: Internal brand, website, SEO, GEO, analytics and connected communication transformation.
- Omnis and KUMEXA are Kumtech ventures in development and are not presented as completed client projects.

## Project process

Projects normally move through contract, invoice and deposit, onboarding, shared project materials, kickoff, production and completion. Standard payment is 50% upfront and 50% on completion. Final scope and pricing are agreed before work begins.

## Referral Program

Kumtech Gateway operates a permanent 10% referral commission programme. Anyone may refer a genuine new client. Commission is 10% of the qualifying Kumtech service fee actually paid, subject to the official eligibility and payout rules.

- [Referral program](https://kumtechgateway.com/referral) — Refer a genuine new client and earn 10% commission on qualifying Kumtech service fees.
- [Referral policy](https://kumtechgateway.com/referral-policy) — Official terms, eligibility, exclusions and payout rules.
